text.original: Owner: The owner is a person, group of persons, a Company, Trust, Institute, Registered Body, State or Central Government & its attached/ subordinate Departments, Undertaking and like in whose name the property stands registered in the revenue records/ government records/ any other legal documents up to the satisfaction of Sanctioning Authority.
